snippet.title: 💥🪑 Last Man Sitting | THE return to office action roguelite | Coming 31st of March 🎆🔫
snippet.description:
From rosy cheeked, grovelling interns to grizzled veterans clinging onto their cups of BEAN-Z, Last Man Sitting should provide you with that work life balance you’ve been waiting for, coming to PC Steam the 31st of March! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/774291/Last_Man_Sitting/

What can you expect on your first day in the office?
- FAST-PACED ACTION. Have you got skills to pay the bills? (Or at least get you to your next paycheck?) Put them to the test in singleplayer or multiplayer co-op in this quick and chaotic, aim-based bullet hell shooter where survival depends on besting a murderous office environment. 

- SIT HAPPENS. With 12 available options, you might struggle to find your favourite Office Chair or Weapon - from the slicing and dicing Katana to shredding Minigun, customise your loadout to suit your playstyle before each session and climb your way to the top.

- DECEPTIVELY DEEP. Get your thinking cap on and choose your Power Ups wisely. With each draft, you get to stack progressively more powerful options and combos, from the annoying Hackerman pop-ups to the destructive Slam Dunk ability.

- OFFICE ANARCHY. Unleash corporate chaos in two distinct game modes. Fight side by side with up to 4 colleagues against a wave of sentient office appliances in the PvE co-op mode, or battle it out “king-of-the-hill-style” in a PvP arena mode where losers get more powerful each round!

Song: tearin' up heart boy - fyoum
